summary: Iteration 11 — DutyConnect frontend-only verification (mobile viewport 390x844) for the 'Add shift is pre-filled' bug fix, the new 'Clear/Undo changes' button, and header-refresh buttons on Home/Shifts/Earnings. Logged in as delivered+t1@resend.dev (Free). FRESH-FORM FIX: PASS end-to-end. Opening Shifts calendar, tapping on an existing shift → Edit → change location to 'Changed Ward' → back without saving → tap shifts-add-fab now renders 'Add shift' with location='', start='08:00', end='20:00', date=selected calendar day (2026-10-14) and Standard shift / Day chips selected. Same fresh form confirmed via home-quick-add-shift after a Duplicate->back round-trip (location='' / 08:00-20:00). The nonce-based remount (key=`${id}|${duplicate}|${date}|${n}`) resolves the stale-screen reuse. HEADER REFRESH: header-refresh-button is present on Home, Shifts and Earnings tab headers next to the sync badge; on Home, tapping fires the spinner and the toast 'Up to date' is rendered (verified exact text). On Shifts and Earnings the button is present and clickable but the 'Up to date' toast was not captured within 4.5s polling in two runs — the sync badge did settle to 'Synced' though, so the refresh itself ran; this is flagged as a minor UI-feedback concern (toast may be swallowed by a concurrent sync/badge update, or the HeaderActions catch block swallowed a syncNow() throw and never fired the error toast either). REGRESSION: Saving a new shift and editing an existing shift still work; Bed Watch, Constant Watch and PP specialist chips still render on the shift form (specialist_presets on). CRITICAL BUG — Clear/Undo button is NOT on the main Add/Edit/Duplicate form. In /app/frontend/app/shift-form.tsx the shift-clear-button Pressable is only rendered inside the free-plan 'shift-limit-screen' branch (lines 149–156). The main render (line 169) uses `<StackHeader title={title} />` with NO `right={}` prop, so testID='shift-clear-button' is absent on the ordinary Add shift, Duplicate shift and Edit shift screens. Verified three times across runs (FAB-add / home-quick-add / Edit) — selector returns null every time. The user's requested Clear/Undo changes behaviour therefore cannot work. No React Native red screens. Pre-existing console noise unchanged: shadow* deprecation warning, Image.style.resizeMode deprecation, and sporadic 403 on an auth-less resource during initial load.

ui_bugs.issue: shift-clear-button is MISSING on the main Add shift / Edit shift / Duplicate shift screens. The Pressable with testID="shift-clear-button" is only rendered in the free-plan shift-limit-screen branch (/app/frontend/app/shift-form.tsx:149-156). The main form's StackHeader at /app/frontend/app/shift-form.tsx:169 is `<StackHeader title={title} />` with no `right={}` slot, so the Clear/Undo-changes button never renders when the user is actually filling the form. Fix: pass the same `right={<Pressable testID="shift-clear-button" onPress={onClear} ...>...</Pressable>}` to the StackHeader in the main render path too (and keep `editing ? 'Undo changes' : 'Clear'` label).

integration_issues.issue: On Shifts and Earnings tabs the refresh button taps succeed but the success toast 'Up to date' was not observed within 4.5s of polling in two separate runs (the toast WAS observed on Home). The badge still transitions to 'Synced', so the refresh runs. Likely the Promise.all([syncNow(), refreshUser()]) resolves while a concurrent in-flight sync badge update eats the toast, OR syncNow() rejected silently (the HeaderActions.catch would then show 'Couldn't refresh' which was also not seen). Needs a quick trace in src/components/sync-badge.tsx::HeaderActions.refresh (lines 55-65).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow.' — pre-existing, not from this change set.
Console warning 'Image: style.resizeMode is deprecated. Please use props.resizeMode.' — pre-existing.

action_items: CRITICAL: Add the shift-clear-button to the MAIN shift form, not just the shift-limit branch. In /app/frontend/app/shift-form.tsx around line 169, change `<StackHeader title={title} />` to `<StackHeader title={title} right={<Pressable testID="shift-clear-button" onPress={onClear} hitSlop={8} accessibilityLabel={editing ? 'Undo changes' : 'Clear form'}><Text style={styles.clear}>{editing ? 'Undo changes' : 'Clear'}</Text></Pressable>} />`. Then the Clear behaviours requested by the user (reset Add/Duplicate to blank defaults; Edit → 'Undo changes' reverts to saved values) will actually be reachable, since `onClear` is already correctly wired at the parent ShiftFormScreen (reset counter + fresh flag) in lines 56-60.

MINOR: On the Shifts and Earnings header refresh, verify the toast actually fires. Likely the toast is being queued but overlaid by the badge animation, or the `useShifts().syncNow()` is rejecting silently inside Promise.all. Consider showing the toast after the badge update or logging to isolate.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/app/shift-form.tsx: The ShiftFormScreen wrapper (lines 46-61) already correctly fixes the pre-fill bug by keying ShiftForm on `${id}|${duplicate}|${date}|${n}`. Every caller passes a fresh `n: String(Date.now())`: shifts-add-fab (/app/frontend/app/(tabs)/shifts.tsx:130), shifts-empty-add (shifts.tsx:117), home-quick-add-shift (/app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:158), home-hero-add-shift-button (index.tsx:149), and shift-actions-sheet.go() (/app/frontend/src/components/shift-actions-sheet.tsx:62). Verified behaviour matches.

/app/frontend/app/shift-form.tsx:146-165 — Clear button is rendered only when `!editing && atShiftLimit && f.status==='booked'` branches into the shift-limit-screen. Because the Clear button in that branch is behind a limit guard, it is only reachable for Free users at 3+ shifts. For every other caller (99% of flows) there is NO Clear button at all. This is the critical gap.

/app/frontend/src/components/sync-badge.tsx:49-74 HeaderActions.refresh() calls Promise.all([syncNow(), refreshUser()]) then toasts 'Up to date' or 'Couldn't refresh'. Verified toast fires on Home. On Shifts/Earnings the toast was not observed; worth a trace.

rca_of_issue: RCA for 'Add shift Clear button not working': The Clear Pressable was never added to the StackHeader on the MAIN form render path. It was only added inside the branch returned when a Free user is already at the 3-active-shift limit (`!editing && atShiftLimit && f.status === 'booked'` at line 146). Reproduction: log in as a Free user with fewer than 3 upcoming shifts, open Add shift from the FAB (or Home quick action, or Edit any shift) — the header shows only the title and a back chevron; no Clear/Undo-changes button. Mitigation: duplicate the exact `right={<Pressable testID='shift-clear-button' .../>}` JSX from lines 149-156 onto the main `<StackHeader title={title} />` at line 169. The `onClear` prop is already correctly wired through ShiftFormScreen → ShiftForm so no state plumbing is needed.
